statement: AMD's accelerator order book is concentrated in a few very large customers, including reported multi-gigawatt commitments from Meta and OpenAI
why: Huge growth resting on two or three buyers is powerful while it lasts and fragile if one of them pauses.

impact.mechanism: Multi-year gigawatt commitments underwrite AMD's ramp but tie its data-centre revenue to a small number of counterparties, so any single deferral moves the whole line.

evidence.excerpt: a Feb 2026 multi-year deal with Meta for up to 6 gigawatts of GPU capacity valued at $60-100 billion over five years

confidence.basis: The customer-commitment detail is flagged in the document as corroborating market reporting, not part of the primary release.

dispersion: Meta deal valued at $60-100 billion over five years; OpenAI deal 6 gigawatts with the first gigawatt in 2H 2026.
